description: Synthetic cli._json_errors error_document, wants_json, and TrackedStream parity.
known_parity_gaps: A lone UTF-16 surrogate cannot be stored in Rust str; no \ud800 error_document vector.
Rust 1.91 makes std::env::set_var unsafe; parity vectors do not set SESSLINT_FORMAT (env fallback covered by cli unit tests in json_errors.rs).
